settings.title: ZCode settings
settings.searchModeHint: Bash keeps search inside the shell. Glob and Grep expose dedicated search tools to the model.
settings.surfaceAllowHint: Comma or space separated inherited tool names.
settings.headlessHint: Suppress interactive-only context and memory extraction.
settings.memoryEnabledHint: Read and inject ZCode workspace memory.
settings.memoryExtractionEnabledHint: Extract memory after successful interactive turns.
settings.compactionEnabledHint: Compact context when pressure reaches the full threshold.
settings.microcompactionEnabledHint: Clear eligible old tool results before full compaction.
settings.compactionThresholdHint: Context pressure ratio for full compaction.
settings.memoryMaxBytesHint: Maximum UTF-8 bytes injected from workspace memory.
